thread.title: Apple tells employees in memo that leaking information risks legal action, Bloomberg reports

title: Apple tells employees in memo that leaking information risks legal action, Bloomberg reports
text:
Apple has caught 29 leakers, of which 12 were arrested, the memo says Company says those that leak 'can face extreme difficulty finding' work elsewhere 
Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) is warning employees not to leak information about future company plans or they risk possible legal action and loss of their jobs, Bloomberg News reported, citing an internal memo. 
Apple has already caught 29 workers whom it found were leaking information, of which 12 were arrested, the report said. 
“These people not only lose their jobs, they can face extreme difficulty finding employment elsewhere,” the company said in the memo. Top stories
